# Dimitri Cole Designs

> Freelance web design by Dimitri Cole Restaino in New York: clean, fast websites for small businesses and passion projects.

Dimitri designed and built each of these six sites, and takes on new work by email.

## Work

- [Ovenlight](https://ovenlight.app/): 2026, the website for Ovenlight, his iPhone app
- [Glitch](https://playglitchgame.com/): 2026, the website for Glitch, his party game of robots, humans and hidden roles
- [Snowy Ghost](https://snowyghost.com/): 2025, redesigned 2026, the home of Snowy Ghost, his app company in New York
- [Patrick the Artist](https://patricktheartist.com/): 2021, a portfolio of character art by Patrick
- [dimitricole.com](https://www.dimitricole.com/): 2019, redesigned 2026, Dimitri's own site
- [Rhinelander Auto Body](https://www.rhinelander.nyc/): 2019, the website for an auto body shop in the Bronx
